resources.string: Your Circle, Live on One Radar
See where trusted friends are in real time with exact distance, live status, and saved hangout spots.
Location sharing starts off. Pause any friend, toggle Ghost Mode in one tap, or stop sharing immediately from anywhere.
Drop pins in 1-to-1 friend chats, bookmark favorite places, and keep optional location history strictly yours.
Share your world only with friends you approve.
Location is never collected unless you explicitly turn sharing on. Zero tracking, zero third-party ad SDKs.
Persistent notification shown while you are actively sharing your GPS location with accepted friends.
Sharing live GPS with accepted friends. Tap Stop to pause immediately.
Notifications for new friend requests and private messages.
WORLDLY only reads your GPS when you toggle sharing ON. A persistent notification stays visible so you are always in control and can stop sharing in one tap.
Location permission is off. Enable location access in System Settings when you are ready to share.
